# Lemo-Opuscar — saare film styles (auto-generated)

Kul **99 styles**.
Source: [lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar/styles](https://github.com/lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar/tree/main/styles) · Credit: Lemomo (LemoLab) · Docs license CC BY-NC 4.0.

**Use:** Claude ko bolo — *"lemo-opuscar se `<Style>` style me `<topic>` par 30 second ki film banao"*. Output: project folder me `final.mp4` (+ poster, subtitles), sab code se rendered.
